department: Division of Materials Science & Engineering (College of Engineering)

deadline.value: College of Engineering PhD deadline is December 15, 2026 for all departments.
deadline.quote: PhD – December 15, 2026 | Deadline to submit all required credentials for PhD applications from international and domestic students to all departments/divisions.

fee_waiver.value: The College of Engineering gives waivers to listed groups (e.g. BU students, veterans, McNair, Fulbright) or others it approves; request by email.
fee_waiver.quote: Other students with approval of BU College of Engineering | Applicants that would like to request a fee waiver may do so by emailing enggrad@bu.edu.

toefl_min.value: College of Engineering minimum is TOEFL iBT 90, or 4.5 on the new scale for tests from January 2026; 100 / 5.0 is encouraged for fellowships.

ielts_min.value: IELTS overall 7.0 is the minimum if TOEFL is unavailable.

english_waiver.value: Waived if you earn a degree at an institution where English is the official language of instruction; the transcript must say so or you upload a letter.
english_waiver.quote: Student has earned or will earn prior to the start of the program an undergraduate or graduate degree from an institution where the official language of instruction is English. | If the transcript does not clearly state that the language of instruction is English, then please upload a supporting document on institutional letterhead

funding.value: PhD students are offered a full financial aid package (BU PhD funding sources require work authorization).
funding.quote: Students who are offered a full financial aid package will not be required to submit any additional financial documentation (unless traveling with dependents). This includes all of our PhD students.

gre_general.value: GRE is optional for applicants with a bachelor's from outside the US.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is optional for applicants who earned a bachelor’s degree outside of the U.S.

entry_route.value: Both post-bachelor's and post-master's PhD routes exist.
entry_route.quote: Materials Science & Engineering (MSE) offers the post-bachelor’s PhD and post-master’s PhD

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Admitted by the College of Engineering.
